notes.title: Update 1.75 (Fogmine Brotherhood)
notes.notes:
🛠 What’s New in Hero Quest


Force Resistance now reduces physical damage taken by a percentage, adding more depth to combat strategy.
Talent costs for party members have been significantly reduced, making progression smoother.
Stat descriptions have been improved for better clarity and understanding.
Updated UI: Opponent special traits (like Cautious Behavior and Initiative) are now displayed when selecting enemies.
New Dungeon: [color=#FFD700]Fogmine[/color] (recommended rating: 700–1400), featuring exciting new gear to collect.
New Friendly Camp: [color=#00FFAA]Shivepoint[/color], which offers quests tied to the Fogmine dungeon.
Spell Vendor UI now filters out spells you already know or have in your inventory.
Potions can now be used on disabled units, allowing for better tactical decisions.
Mana Potions have been added to help sustain spellcasting during longer battles.
Mortal Strike now deals an additional 8% of the target’s max HP as bonus damage.
Sweeping Strike no longer splits damage between multiple targets — each target now takes full damage.
New Spell: Icy Breath (Frost Mage) – Deals damage in a 90° cone in the selected direction.
New Spell: Holy Nova (Cleric) – Bursts from the caster, damaging enemies and healing allies in range.


🐞 Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue where purchasing quest items from the market didn’t complete the quest.
Passive spells can no longer be dragged or repositioned.
Frost Nova now correctly applies a freezing effect in addition to damage.
Fixed a dungeon loading bug that could lock the game if closed during loading.
Resolved UI issues with item sets.
Fixed a crash caused by the Revenge spell under specific conditions.
Fixed a bug where opening the inventory in a friendly town before moving could freeze the player.
Fixed an issue where spells couldn't be learned from spell bags.
Corrected hero appearance selection issues caused by specific class and spell combinations.
Fixed an issue where items couldn’t be swapped from bags to the backpack.
Fixed a bug allowing non-collectible items to be added to the collection inventory.
Addressed an issue where the level-up popup appeared multiple times for the same level.
Vitality is now correctly tracked as one of the Dark Knight's primary stats.
